Before you enter anything

  • Official rules govern. Read them yourself before entering.
  • Ledger values are from 2026-08-19 and have not been re-checked, except the rows marked above.
  • Sportsbook, casino and real-money DFS contests are excluded by the source's own policy. Several listed rows conflict with that policy (see Flagged).
  • Prize winners may owe tax paperwork. US prizes of $600 or more typically need a W-9. Taxes are the winner's responsibility.
